subject: Issues with rhandsontable would require feedback from Shiny developpers

messages.author: 3fd19fd766bba142
messages.subject: Issues with rhandsontable would require feedback from Shiny developpers
parts:
Hi,

I recently posted an issue on the Github repository of Jonathan Rowen, who maintains the rhandsontable package. After looking into my bug report, Jonathan indicated that the problem may be linked to how Shiny handles "live shiny widget" (I quote here, I must admit that I do not know what these terms actually mean) and suggested that @jcheng5 may provide some insight on the reported issue.

So I am posting this message with the hope that this problem could be further evaluated and solved.

I would like invite @jcheng5 or anyone interested in this issue to read the thread of Jonathan's Github page (issue) which provides a full description of the problem and reproducible examples.

Thank you in advance for your time and help
